params.name: aField
params.description: Field whose storage location you want to get. Must be an actual field reference (e.g. [Table]FieldName) of type Text, BLOB, or Picture -- the doc's own Type column ("Text, Blob, Picture") names the field's data type, not the shape of a value that can be passed here; a same-typed variable or literal is rejected by the compiler ("The function expects a field not a variable or constant.").

constraints: Returns an empty string if the field's data is not stored externally, if the field has a Null value, or when called from a remote 4D.
The returned pathname is given even if the target file does not exist or is not accessible.
